reason: Unit-tier: wiring is not application. heading: ## Boundary
reason: Unit-tier: the section is a ROUTING TABLE, and a misroute is otherwise silent — nothing in the toolchain objects to a section written into the wrong spec file, and for one class the silence is total: `heading_coverage` SKIPS `## Scenario:` headings in every file EXCEPT `scenarios.md`, so a scenario parked elsewhere is exempt from the registry and reads exactly like a scenario nobody wrote. Each bullet is asserted in the direction it constrains — the named content is in the file the bullet names, the content the boundary routes AWAY is absent from this file, acceptance scenarios live only where the gate reads them, and a heading this file shares with a sibling (today `## Self-application`) must CITE that sibling rather than restate it, since two definitions of one rule drift. heading: ## Testing approach
reason: Unit-tier: the H3 "Scenario-tier coverage" rules applied to this repository's own registry, in the three directions no shipped check covers here. heading: ## Typechecker rule set
reason: Unit-tier: strict mode plus the seven strict-plus diagnostics, read FROM the section's bullet list. heading: ## Code coverage thresholds

heading: ## Structural pattern matching
reason: Unit-tier: the `<subject>` half of `case _: assert_never(<subject>)`, which the shipped `assert_never_exhaustiveness` check explicitly does not verify ("Subsequent cycles can tighten to verify the call's argument equals the match subject"). The argument is the whole mechanism: pyright narrows the SUBJECT to `Never` once every variant is handled, so a call pointed at any other expression computes that narrowing for a value nobody asked about — the arm still looks right, the shipped check still passes, and the exhaustiveness check silently stops checking. Nothing notices at runtime either, because `[tool.coverage.report].exclude_also` carries `case _:` and the arm is never measured (plan fleet-heading-coverage-convergence P2 burn-down, livespec-dev-tooling-hj42cw).

## Scenario: JIT replacement is immediate but installation-budgeted
reason: Consumer-tier: the two halves of the clause, read off the committed pool gitops the fleet controller runs under. IMMEDIATE — the fleet-owned Kueue `Configuration`'s ACTIVE lines must not enable `waitForPodsReady`, the one committed knob that gates admission on a per-workload timeout and so serializes healthy replenishment. BUDGETED — every routed scale set must name ONE `githubConfigSecret`, because a mint pair can only be accounted against a SHARED installation budget if there is one installation to share; a second secret silently splits the budget while every consumer keeps reading it as one (plan fleet-heading-coverage-convergence P2 burn-down, livespec-dev-tooling-qa4fwa).

heading: ## Scenario: JIT startup batch immediately admits all permitted demand within the half-budget point burst
reason: Consumer-tier: the node profile's registered churn-slot capacity — the batch's remaining-physical-capacity term — converted at the section's stated ten points per mint pair and asserted to fit inside the 450-point half-budget burst, i.e. 45 pairs. Raised past it, as C was to 64 for two hours on 2026-09-06, a cold start can no longer reach capacity in the startup batch and nothing reports that the guarantee lapsed. A second assertion keeps the bound non-vacuous: the summed committed per-repository ceilings must EXCEED the burst, which is the 'even when more demand remains' state the clause governs (plan fleet-heading-coverage-convergence P2 burn-down, livespec-dev-tooling-qa4fwa).

heading: ## Scenario: JIT throttle opens one shared circuit
reason: Consumer-tier: ONE — every routed scale set's LocalQueue must resolve to a ClusterQueue inside the single `fleet-ci-runner-pool` cohort, or the boundary the throttle opens is several circuits wearing one name. NO EVICTION — no cohort member may state a preemption policy other than `Never`, because with the circuit open queued demand stays pending by design and a preempting queue would spend that wait evicting the healthy registered runners the section requires to remain available (plan fleet-heading-coverage-convergence P2 burn-down, livespec-dev-tooling-qa4fwa).

heading: ## Scenario: JIT fleet capacity borrows fairly without exceeding 482 runners
reason: Consumer-tier: the two halves of the clause, read off the committed pool gitops the fleet controller runs under. BORROWS FAIRLY — no `fleet-ci-runner-pool` member may state a `borrowingLimit` (Kueue's default lends the cohort's whole unused nominal quota, and `0` pins every repository to its guaranteed floor while the pool idles), and each routed scale set's `maxRunners` must sit strictly ABOVE its own fair share and no higher than the cohort's total borrowable — at or under the share the repository can never spend what a peer lends it, above the cohort total the surplus is the pending-object backlog the Given says must wait at the forge. WITHOUT EXCEEDING 482 — the bound is the cohort's summed fair shares, and the ENFORCER is the node's finite `ci-runner.io/churn-slot`, not Kueue: VALIDATION_CHECKLIST.md item 7 measured Kueue marking six workloads Admitted while four pods ran, so a scale set that does not request AND limit exactly one slot is outside the only authoritative gate. Control arms feed both readers a synthetic counter-example (plan fleet-heading-coverage-convergence P2 burn-down, livespec-dev-tooling-7qkfv2).

heading: ## Scenario: JIT circuit state survives restart without a reburst
reason: Consumer-tier: what a restart can and cannot do TO THE POOL, which is the half of the scenario that lands in this repository — the circuit's own bookkeeping is ARC's controller's and a confirmed gap, per ci-runner/k3s/phase2/README.md §"What does NOT move to Kueue/ARC". RECOVER BEFORE ADMITTING — the k3s datastore is tmpfs, so the node's churn-slot capacity and the App installation secret are restored by two systemd units that must be ordered strictly before `converge-ci-stack.service` (the unit that applies the queues, the controller and every scale set), asserted in BOTH directions because systemd takes either edge alone and the converge otherwise runs against state it never recovered. NO NEW STARTUP BURST — every routed scale set must declare `minRunners: 0`, since a non-zero baseline is minted the moment the listener starts, ahead of any recovered state and again on every restart. NO INFINITE RESTART LOOP — the minted ephemeral runner's JIT config is single-use so `Restart=no` is load-bearing, and the long-lived supervisor's `RestartSec` must be non-zero (systemd's default is 100 ms). Control arms feed all three readers a synthetic counter-example (plan fleet-heading-coverage-convergence P2 burn-down, livespec-dev-tooling-7qkfv2).

heading: ## Scenario: a routed job reads the warm cache and cannot write it
reason: Consumer-tier: the committed gitops the scenario's runtime facts are produced BY, since no test here starts a pod. RESOLVE WITHOUT CONTACTING THE INDEX — uv reads `UV_CACHE_DIR` and nothing else, so it must name the path the provisioner seeded, and cargo reaches the host only through the postStart's `[source.crates-io] replace-with` onto the node-local crates proxy; either one wrong is a job that quietly fetches from the public index. NOT A SHARED INODE — the flag on the provisioner's one `cp` IS the clause: `cp -al` (the hardlink seed retired 2026-09-06) hands the job the GENERATION'S inodes, a plain `cp -a` is private but pays the per-start byte copy the README records as the cost the reflink replaced, and `--reflink=always` also makes a reflink-less filesystem leave NO seed rather than fall back to bytes. CREATE AN ENTRY BESIDE THE SEED — seeded files keep the generation's root ownership, so only the setup script's widened directory modes make the tier usable. THE SPAN — the postStart must record a warm-copy row whose hit CAN be true for each tier (the kill-switch and canary arms record a literal false on purpose) and the emitter must replay it as `cache.warm-copy` with `build.cache.hit`. The runtime proof is the pool's isolation suite running inside a routed job, so its `warm-seed-private` case is asserted to still carry a failing verdict. Control arms feed every reader a synthetic counter-example (plan fleet-heading-coverage-convergence P2 burn-down, livespec-dev-tooling-pzqviv).

heading: ## Scenario: a job's compilation-cache writes are refused
reason: Consumer-tier: the two layers the refusal rests on, asserted separately because either alone stays green while the trust argument is gone. THE READ-ONLY ENDPOINT — a job pod carries no credential, so it connects as the unauthenticated `default` user, and "read-only endpoint" is exactly the ACL `converge-sccache-redis.sh` renders into the `sccache-redis-acl` Secret: that user may hold no write capability, and every user must build up from an explicit `-@all` reset since redis applies ACL rules in order. COMPILE LOCALLY IN THE JOB — sccache is a `rustc-wrapper` around the real compiler; a `SCCACHE_DIST_*` scheduler in the pod env would ship the compile to a build farm (still a green job, no longer this job), and the wrapper stanza must be gated on the backend answering a probe so an unreachable cache leaves a plain local compile. NOT IN THE SHARED CACHE / REFUSED BY THE BACKEND — the CLIENT layer is `SCCACHE_REDIS_RW_MODE=READ_ONLY` (a job never attempts the write) and the SERVER layer is the ACL (a write that IS attempted returns NOPERM); the spec requires server-side enforcement because the client layer is good manners a workflow could undo, and the ACL alone is not enough either, so no job-visible env name may look like a writer credential. The runtime proof is the isolation suite's own SET from inside a routed job, so its `redis-set-refused` and `no-writer-credential` cases are asserted to still carry a failing verdict. Control arms feed every reader a synthetic counter-example (plan fleet-heading-coverage-convergence P2 burn-down, livespec-dev-tooling-pzqviv).

heading: ## Adaptive JIT runner admission budget
reason: Unit-tier over the committed manifests: the three STATIC terms of the section's `min()` live in three different hand-maintained files, and the relations between them are what the section states rather than what any one file says. Asserts each scale set's `maxRunners` is the bounded multiple of its ClusterQueue `nominalQuota` in both directions (too high materializes the backlog as pending admission objects the clause says must wait at the forge; collapsed to the quota, the borrowing clause becomes unreachable), and siblings assert the fair shares sum to the node profile's `ADMISSION_CAPACITY_C` and that no committed path reaches the 482 physical cap or derives its doubling (plan fleet-heading-coverage-convergence P2 burn-down, livespec-dev-tooling-6zgtmv).

heading: ## Runner-pool build cache tiers
reason: Unit-tier over the committed cache tree: the section's single-sourcing clause — the byte and file budgets "stated in exactly one committed place that governs BOTH the populator's refusal and the node's lifecycle sweep's judgement". Asserts the one ConfigMap states both axes, that the populator receives them from it and restates neither (a second copy drifts, and the two readers then disagree silently about the same generation), that the sweep judges against that same place, and — in siblings — that an absent budget fails closed, that the over-budget arm sets the new generation aside without touching the live symlink, and that every populator build carries the nice/ionice and admitted-job guardrails (plan fleet-heading-coverage-convergence P2 burn-down, livespec-dev-tooling-6zgtmv).

heading: ## Runner-pool cache telemetry
reason: Unit-tier over the committed emitters: "one attribute per cacheable operation [...] never as a single aggregate that hides which tier missed", asserted as the per-tier span carrying its tier identity next to its hit and every cache attribute sitting in the `build.cache.*` scheme namespace. Siblings assert the fleet scheme attributes ride the common set, that the cold canary is deterministic, applies only when the operator switch is unset and is tagged distinctly from it (a random draw yields the right cold FRACTION and destroys the reproducibility the standing query rests on), and that the dead-man trigger counts the one gauge the host emitter always emits (plan fleet-heading-coverage-convergence P2 burn-down, livespec-dev-tooling-6zgtmv).

heading: ## Runner-pool node rebuild recipe
reason: Unit-tier over the committed recipe: "the procedure MUST NOT embed a value that belongs to one node", asserted as the negative — no node-identifying value of any committed profile appears in any stage's executable text. A hardcoded device or address does not break the node it was copied from; it breaks the SECOND node by doing the first node's thing to it, on the one day the recipe is exercised. Siblings assert both profiles declare one key vocabulary, that the consent gate refuses NAMING the volume it refused, and that the documented sequence's step 1 is the bare-metal stage (plan fleet-heading-coverage-convergence P2 burn-down, livespec-dev-tooling-6zgtmv).
